_comment: RAAM parameters. Items under 'ambiguities' are interpretations of the paper that are still open - see memory/TRADING-STRATEGY.md before changing them.

portfolio.name: Core & Shield
portfolio._note: Core = 50% QQQM (Nasdaq-100) held only while QQQM's month-end close is above its 10-month average (core_trend); otherwise the Core's 50% goes to the cash asset (SGOV). Shield = RAAM on shield_weight of the portfolio. max_weight caps a symbol's total portfolio weight (excess to cash). Owner decision 2026-10-14, live from the 2026-10 signal (2 Nov rebalance); previous Core was a fixed 30% SPY + 20% AGG.

universe._note_sell_only: Holdings from earlier rules that the rebalance sells to zero and never buys. SPY was the previous Core; BIL, TIP and IBIT were replaced by the lower-fee SGOV, SCHP and BTC (owner decision 2026-10-15). All are sold at the 2 Nov 2026 rebalance. Remove once sold.

asset_class.BTC: Crypto (spot Bitcoin ETF, Grayscale Bitcoin Mini Trust)

execution._note_max_order: 55% so a fresh 50% QQQM Core buy (start, or re-entry after the trend filter or breaker) isn't blocked.

_tier1: 2026-09-23 Tier 1 upgrades: cash=BIL (was SHY), momentum hurdle = cash momentum (was 0), breaker -20% with auto re-entry at next monthly rebalance (was -15% manual reset).
_improvement_A: 2026-09-23 improvement A: ATR trend term removed from the score (w_trend 0); trend still computed and logged. Set w_trend 1 to restore the paper's rule.
_core_and_shield: 2026-09-24 Core & Shield: 50% fixed 60/40 core (SPY/AGG) + 50% RAAM shield. Per-order cap raised 25% -> 35% because core targets reach 30%.

report_norms._note: QQQM trend Core + Shield (Bitcoin capped 5%) normal ranges from the 2015-2026 backtest (memory/BACKTEST-SUMMARY.md); used by scripts/report.py only.

_ibit: 2026-09-26 IBIT (spot Bitcoin ETF) added as 12th Shield candidate, capped at 5% of the portfolio (excess to BIL). Adopted before the first trade.
_low_fee_swaps: 2026-10-15 owner decision, live from the 2026-10 signal (2 Nov rebalance): same exposures, lower fees. Cash BIL (0.136%) -> SGOV (0.09%); TIP (0.18%) -> SCHP (0.03%); IBIT (0.25%) -> BTC, Grayscale Bitcoin Mini Trust (0.15%), still capped at 5%. DBC kept: PDBC is cheaper but trailed DBC by ~0.4pp/yr over 5 years.
